revision: Three branched rounds / individual corroborated innocent accounts
fairness: Every innocent account supplies a connection to an authenticated continuous source spanning the contamination window. Each also reveals independently suspicious misconduct. The murderer account supplies no valid such connection: its activity is remote, prerecorded, outside the enclosure, or not continuous. Fixed evidence authenticates generic sources and intervals, not personal biographies or thirty named alibis. Match all three statements to the source constraints and corrected clock. Evidence does not require an absent player. No pre-vote branch confesses; Coming Clean adds no essential innocent proof.
difficulty_limit: Complete information intentionally permits eliminating every innocent, as requested. This establishes logical fairness, not a measured human difficulty level. No new blind player trial has been run.
record_identity_rule: Certified sources withhold character identity, job title, conversation content and personal activity details. A generic occupied source can exist without the corresponding character using it: ordinary non-playing museum staff and scheduled guests also use these facilities. They are not additional murder suspects. Testimony supplies the personal connection to a source; the innocent and murderer accounts make different claims about that connection. No extract asserts that a particular character performed an activity regardless of branch. Both the source and operating constraints remain fixed.
